findings.description: The bucket is public (per the configuration comment) while storing customer-master.xlsx, a customer data file. Anyone on the internet can read this sensitive data, exposing it beyond the intended boundary.
The bucket storing customer data has no server-side encryption configuration, so customer-master.xlsx is stored in plaintext at rest and readable if the underlying storage is accessed.
The bucket stores financial data but has no server-side encryption, leaving sensitive financial information in plaintext at rest.
The operations bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, so the data it holds is stored unencrypted at rest.
The data science bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, so the data it holds is stored unencrypted at rest.
